Public holiday calendars. ICS files: one VEVENT per holiday day (DTEND exclusive), regional holidays flagged with X-SUBDIVISION.
CN: multi-day blocks (DTEND exclusive) + '调休上班' make-up working days (CATEGORIES:班 = working day on a weekend).
JP: government CSV (Shift_JIS), '休日' = substitute/bridge holiday.
Lunar/Islamic dates for 2027 are provisional.
